description: OCO calls (uid TESTUID): input.method is place_oco, modify_oco or cancel_oco, input.uid the user id, input.alert_id the alert id (modify_oco and cancel_oco), input.params the other arguments in the Python names: exchange, tradingsymbol, transaction_type, quantity, product, stop_loss and target (each a leg object {trigger_value, price, order_type, trigger_price}; absent optional keys are omitted, order_type defaults to LIMIT), tag, validity (the leg retention, default DAY) and alert_validity (DAY or GTT, default GTT; both required on modify_oco). expected is {endpoint, payload}: payload is the exact request body as a nested object whose KEY ORDER IS PART OF THE CONTRACT (this file is written unsorted; compare the encoded text, not the parsed object). PlaceOCOOrder: uid, tsym, exch, validity (the alert_validity), ai_t (LMT_BOS_O for BUY, LMT_SOB_O for SELL), oivariable (a list of two objects, {var_name: x, d: stop-loss trigger} then {var_name: y, d: target trigger}), place_order_params (the stop-loss leg), place_order_params_leg2 (the target leg). ModifyOCOOrder: the same with al_id second, after uid. CancelOCOOrder: uid, al_id. A leg: tsym, exch, trantype (B or S, the OCO's side), prctyp (LMT, MKT, SL-LMT, SL-MKT), prd (C, M, H), ret (the validity), actid and uid (both the user id), qty, prc, ordersource (API), then trgprc and remarks (the tag) when given; there is no top-level actid, remarks, dscqty or algo_id. Every number is a string, sent as given (trigger values and prices keep their digits); a MARKET or SL-MKT leg without a price sends prc '0'. An error case is {error: RequestValidationError, loc: [...]}, the path of the one error in wire names (an array index is a JSON number): a field of one leg is under its leg key (place_order_params for the stop-loss leg, place_order_params_leg2 for the target leg: prc, trgprc, prctyp), a trigger value under oivariable and its index (0 stop-loss, 1 target) then d, a field both legs share under its bare wire key (exch, prd, qty, trantype, al_id), and the side rule (BUY: the stop-loss trigger must be above the target trigger, SELL: below it, equal refused; checked only when both triggers are valid numbers) under oivariable. Exchanges NSE, NFO, BSE, BFO, MCX; products CNC, NRML, CO (MIS and BO refused).
